preToolUse.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command" <<< "$(cat)"); echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE "rm\s+-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*\s+/" && { echo "BLOCKED: rm -rf / is not permitted." >&2; exit 2; }; echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE "git (commit|push|merge|rebase).*--no-verify" && { echo "BLOCKED: --no-verify is not permitted." >&2; exit 2; }; echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE "git push.+--force([^-]|$)" && { echo "BLOCKED: git push --force is not permitted. Use --force-with-lease instead." >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0'
